questions.q: According to the Second Law of Motion, for a given force, acceleration is inversely proportional to the _________ of an object.
options: mass <a class="wp_basic_quiz_showans_btn" onclick="if (!window.__cfRLUnblockHandlers) return false; if(jQuery(this).hasClass('showanswer')){ jQuery(this).html('
questions.explain: Newton’s second law of motion can be formally stated as follows : The acceleration of an object as produced by a net force is directly proportional to the magnitude of the net force, in the same direction as the net force, and inversely proportional to the mass of the object.

questions.q: During _____________ motion of an object along a straight line, the change in velocity of the object for any time interval is zero.
options: uniform <a class="wp_basic_quiz_showans_btn" onclick="if (!window.__cfRLUnblockHandlers) return false; if(jQuery(this).hasClass('showanswer')){ jQuery(this).html('
questions.explain: During uniform motion of an object along a straight line, the velocity remains constant with time. In this case, the change in velocity of the object for any time interval is zero. This means, in the case of uniform motion, the rate of change of velocity, i. e. acceleration is equal to zero.

questions.q: The Laser is a beam of radiations which are____:
options: Coherent and non-monochromatic <a class="wp_basic_quiz_showans_btn" onclick="if (!window.__cfRLUnblockHandlers) return false; if(jQuery(this).hasClass('showanswer')){ jQuery(this).html('
questions.explain: Laser, an acronym for Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation, creates a radiation beam that is coherent (in-phase). In a coherent light source, the amplitude of the radiated waves is added that results in a radiation beam of great intensity. It normally produces only one or two wavelengths. The single wavelength is called monochromatic radiation.

questions.q: Curie point is the temperature at which____:
options: Transmutation of metal occurs. <a class="wp_basic_quiz_showans_btn" onclick="if (!window.__cfRLUnblockHandlers) return false; if(jQuery(this).hasClass('showanswer')){ jQuery(this).html('
questions.explain: The Curie temperature (Tc), or Curie point, is the temperature at which a ferromagnetic material becomes paramagnetic on heating; the effect is reversible. A magnet will lose its magnetism if heated above the Curie temperature. The paramagnetic are feebly magnetic in nature than ferromagnetic materials such as iron, cobalt and nickel.
